original_ai_output.title_zh: 奥贡州青年抗议州长修路承诺迟迟未兑现
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚奥贡州西部青年在阿拉马拉一带的快速路沿线聚集，抗议阿贝奥库塔–奥洛伦达–伊梅科公路状况恶化。抗议者举牌要求州长兑现2026年1月作出的道路重建承诺，并呼吁提供项目进展说明。该事件目前为单一来源报道。

location.raw_text: Alamala axis of the expressway, Ogun West Senatorial District, Ogun State

key_facts.fact: 奥贡州西部青年抗议阿贝奥库塔–奥洛伦达–伊梅科公路状况恶化
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Youths in Ogun West have protested the deplorable state of the Abeokuta–Olorunda–Imeko Road

key_facts.fact: 抗议者聚集在快速路阿拉马拉一带并举牌示威
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The youths gathered in their numbers along the Alamala axis of the expressway on Saturday to protest the deplorable state of the road, carrying placards

key_facts.fact: 抗议者要求州长就2026年1月承诺的道路重建项目提供进展说明
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: urged Governor Dapo Abiodun to provide an update on the project and take concrete steps towards its implementation
